# Competitor Profiling Skill for Muse

💳 Paid API required: the full profiling workflow runs on Firecrawl (site scraping) and DataForSEO (SEO intelligence), which are paid third-party services.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT) by @coreyhaines31, listed here with credit to its creator. Turns Muse into a competitive-intelligence analyst: give it competitor URLs and it builds structured, comparable competitor dossiers — homepage and pricing scraping for positioning, features, and messaging, review mining on G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, and Product Hunt, backlink and domain-authority data, ranked-keyword and traffic intelligence, top organic pages, and content-strategy signals — then synthesizes everything into a dated profile markdown (at a glance, positioning, features, pricing, customers, SEO, strengths and weaknesses, implications for your product) plus a cross-competitor _summary.md with a comparison table, positioning map, and market gaps. Raw scrape/SEO/review data is saved to disk first for auditability, with a quick-scan mode (homepage + pricing only) and a deep-profile mode, parallel scraping for multiple competitors, and an explicit change log when profiles are updated. Its posture: facts over opinions — every claim traceable to a source, inferences labeled, staleness flagged; and it treats scraped competitor pages as untrusted input, ignoring hidden instructions aimed at AI agents and noting the attempt.
